Chicago Equity Partners Continues to Hold Position in Paycom Software (PAYC); As Reeds Com (REED) Valuation Declined, Holder North Star Investment Management Lowered Holding by $390,148 
March 7, 2018 - By Vivian Park 
Chicago Equity Partners Llc increased its stake in Paycom Software Inc (PAYC) by 210.98% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chicago Equity Partners Llc bought 16,815 shares as the company’s stock rose 21.56% with the market. The institutional investor held 24,785 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.86 million, up from 7,970 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chicago Equity Partners Llc who had been investing in Paycom Software Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.36 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.55% or $1.64   $107.5. About 621,384 shares traded. Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) has risen 61.78%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.08% the S&P500. 
North Star Investment Management Corp decreased its stake in Reeds Inc Com (REED) by 95.24% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. North Star Investment Management Corp sold 195,074 shares as the company’s stock declined 18.75% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 9,750 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $21,000, down from 204,824 at the end of the previous reported quarter. North Star Investment Management Corp who had been investing in Reeds Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $36.93 million market cap company. It closed at $1.5 lastly. It is down 15.36%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 32.06% the S&P500. 
Chicago Equity Partners Llc, which manages about $10.49B and $3.16 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Comerica Inc (NYSE:CMA) by 10,175 shares to 26,365 shares, valued at $2.01M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Sjw Group (NYSE:SJW) by 8,007 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 49,060 shares, and cut its stake in Crane Co (NYSE:CR). 
Among 18 analysts covering Paycom Software ( NYSE:PAYC ), 13 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 72% are positive. Paycom Software had 64 analyst reports since August 5, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Stifel Nicolaus maintained Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) rating on Wednesday, August 5. Stifel Nicolaus has “Buy” rating and $38 target. Robert W. Baird maintained Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) on Tuesday, February 6 with “Buy” rating. As per Wednesday, November 1, the company rating was downgraded by Credit Suisse. As per Tuesday, September 13, the company rating was maintained by Barclays Capital. The firm has “Buy” rating by Stifel Nicolaus given on Thursday, June 16. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Hold” rating and $74.0 target in Sunday, September 3 report. The stock of Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) has “Outperform” rating given on Friday, May 12 by Wells Fargo. The stock has “Neutral” rating by JP Morgan on Wednesday, November 2. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, November 1 by Jefferies. Mizuho maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Thursday, October 12 report. 
North Star Investment Management Corp, which manages about $789.57M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,611 shares to 99,612 shares, valued at $15.35M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Wisdomtree Invts Inc Com (NASDAQ:WETF) by 60,784 shares in the quarter, for a total of 398,873 shares, and has risen its stake in Freeport (NYSE:FCX).   Vivian Park
